successors.name: British Cape Colony
successors.text: 'near the junction of the Vaal and Orange rivers' with Kimberley and Barkly West; infobox 'Area (estimate): 40,000 km2'

ledger.x: c. 1800: the Griqua polity of Griqualand West is established. Infobox 'Established: 1800'; the Griqua capital was Klaarwater (Griquatown) and 'Andries Waterboer took over control and founded the powerful Waterboer dynasty'.
30 July 1870: diggers proclaim the Klipdrift Republic on the diamond fields.
27 October 1871: the Griqua polity becomes British territory under the same borders.
1873: Griqualand West becomes a Crown colony: 'In 1873 it was proclaimed as a British colony, with its capital at' Kimberley.
18 October 1880: Griqualand West is united with the Cape Colony.
18 October 1880: the Griqualand West Colony ends in the Cape Colony.

certainty.note: British colony; the page gives no boundary description, only the diamond fields' location.
